notes: Older receivers with the seat close to the back speakers now finish (the bass timing stays inside the receiver's delay window); a subwoofer set very low no longer stops the run (the balance is kept, the app tells you to raise its volume next time); slightly disagreeing main-position sweeps no longer refuse the folder; the treble fall angle goes to 2 dB/oct; clearer wording. Includes every fix since 0.9.9. Install over your current version — settings and results carry over.
